events.verdict: Ayton (PHX) makes contact to the body of Ibaka (TOR) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Siakam (TOR) makes incidental contact to the arm of Warren (PHX) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) makes contact to the arm of Ibaka (TOR) in the post but does not affect his SQBR.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) makes contact to the arm of Siakam (TOR) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Siakam (TOR) beats Warren (PHX) to the spot but delivers some contact during the drive that does not affect Warren's SQBR.
Lowry (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Warren (PHX) at the end of his drive.
Ayton (PHX) slightly extends his arm against Green's (TOR) side during the pick but he is able to move through contact.
VanVleet (TOR) does not get directly into Booker's (PHX) path therefore the contact from Booker does not dislodge him from legal guarding position.
Ibaka (TOR) firms up on Bridges's (PHX) side during the pick but he is able to move through contact.
Ibaka (TOR) makes contact with Bridges (PHX) and affects his movement during the loose ball.
Ayton (PHX) jumps slightly from point A to point B and makes contact with Siakam (TOR) but does not affect his driving shot attempt.
